packageRules.description: Runtime and extras dependencies are capped (e.g. numpy<3, qoolqit<1.7). 'widen' raises the cap and keeps the old versions supported (numpy>=2,<3 becomes numpy>=2,<4). Renovate forbids rangeStrategy in rules that use matchUpdateTypes, so it gets its own rule.

Python dependencies: no per-package PRs and no changes to the pyproject.toml constraints; uv.lock is refreshed as a whole by lockFileMaintenance. Vulnerability fixes still get their own PRs (vulnerabilityAlerts.enabled overrides this rule).
Runtime and extras dependencies are capped at the next major: propose raising the cap when a new major is out.
qoolqit is capped at the next minor (qoolqit>=1.6.0,<1.7): also propose raising the cap for new minors. No release-age wait, like its uv cooldown exemption.
